Two-surface architecture established (DEC-20260503-A): *[*strale.io*](http://strale.io)* as *-Assurance product family home, [strale.dev](http://strale.dev) as agent capabilities API. SQS engine deleted in favour of per-product routing (DEC-20260503-B). Hosting consolidated to Railway, monorepo established (DEC-20260503-C). Payee Assurance references updated to Counterparty Assurance per DEC-20260502-A. 2026-04-20: Workspace reorganised into 9 sections.\* **Strale delivers decision-ready outcomes for agents. Our first product, Counterparty Assurance, returns a complete counterparty answer in a single auditable call: identity, sanctions, ownership, bank verification.** Strale operates two public surfaces under one company. [**strale.io**](http://strale.io) is home to the *-Assurance product family — Counterparty Assurance is the flagship; Web3 Assurance is live; future *-Assurance products plug in here. [**strale.dev**](http://strale.dev) is the agent capabilities API: atomic capabilities exposed to agents and developers, priced per call, paid via x402, Stripe pre-paid balance, MPP, or Stripe Link for Agents. Both surfaces share one backend ([api.strale.io](http://api.strale.io)), one billing infrastructure, and one source-health substrate. Underneath the products sits decision infrastructure for agent workflows — six substrate capabilities (discovery, routing, orchestration, entity resolution, decision-readiness, audit trail) that \*-Assurance products are built on. Coverage across EU and UK via direct government registry integrations and licensed providers. Strale is operated by Moonlighter AB, Stockholm. --- # Where to find things
